notes: Henan Shuanghui Investment & Development Co Ltd (SZSE: 000895) — China's largest pork processor. ~73% owned by WH Group (HK-listed Smithfield parent). Vertically integrated meat-processing, packaged meats, fresh pork, and downstream meat distribution. Reports CNY-millions PRC GAAP. Lists in CNY on Shenzhen Stock Exchange. FY ends Dec 31. Asset-light vs upstream pork producers (Muyuan / New Hope Liuhe) — Shuanghui is processor/marketer, not large-scale farm operator. Modest leverage. Revenue down vs FY20 peak as China hog cycle and consumer demand softened. High-payout dividend stock — known for distributing >90% of net income via H1 + H2 cash dividends.

periods.notes: FY20: Revenue RMB73.9bn — peak year. NI RMB6.26bn. ASF-driven pork price super-cycle drove strong unit economics on packaged meat segment. Detailed balance-sheet line items not retrieved for this period via English aggregators.
FY21: Revenue RMB66.8bn (-10% YoY) on hog price normalization post-ASF. EBITDA RMB7.06bn (margin 10.6%). NI RMB4.87bn (-22%). Net cash RMB4.3bn. DPS RMB1.68.
FY22: Revenue RMB62.7bn (-6%). EBITDA RMB7.81bn (margin 12.4%) — packaged meats benefited from improved hog input cost. NI RMB5.62bn (+16%). DPS RMB1.898 (peak payout).
FY23: Revenue RMB60.1bn (-4%). EBITDA RMB7.79bn (margin 13.0%). NI RMB5.05bn (-10%). Net debt swung to +RMB4.4bn after large dividend distribution + working capital. DPS RMB1.75.
FY24: Revenue RMB59.7bn (-1%). EBITDA RMB8.36bn (margin 14.0%) — best margin year of cycle on lower hog input costs. NI RMB4.99bn (-1%). DPS reduced to RMB1.40 (still ~97% payout).
FY25: Revenue RMB59.27bn (-0.48% YoY). NI RMB5.105bn (+2.32%) — modest recovery. Total external meat sales volume grew. Detailed balance sheet pending.
